votes.reason: The target now says "La media importa menos que cómo se agrupan los fallos." This brings back the clustering sense of "failure cluster", which the next paragraph relies on ("todas las regresiones aparecen en…", "todos los casos fallidos usan una herramienta concreta").
The target now says "El objetivo es que sea más fácil razonar sobre el sistema." The "razonar sobre" construction is natural Spanish, and the calque "el sistema sea más fácil de razonar" is gone.
The target now says "no llega con la verdad de referencia grapada." This keeps the single stapling image from "stapled to it" and drops the mixed "cosida con grapas".

The main drift is fixed. The target now says "Mastra también puede asociar scorers directamente…", "Los scorers en producción se ejecutan…" and "`runEvals` admite configuraciones de scorers", which matches the API term used elsewhere. Two small inconsistencies remain: "workflow" still alternates with "rama del flujo de trabajo" and "paso del flujo de trabajo". They are recognizable equivalents, so this is polish only. "En producción" is supported by the source's "production response" and "production traffic".

The target now says "Si todos los modelos baratos fallan en los mismos dos casos ambiguos, necesitas lógica de escalado". This restores the cross-model quantifier from "every cheap model", so the diagnostic reasoning is intact again.

The target now says "Las evals premian los puntos de separación…". The gender now matches the later "las evals dejan de parecer", and "uniones" is gone. My concern about the rhythm of the new wording is tracked separately in 3c7690040fdbe9403f6d.
This duplicates b8639f85dc50cb706d06. "cosida con grapas" has been replaced with "grapada".

The target still says "no es más que intuición con una tabla de despacho". I agree with the peers that "no es más que" keeps some of the dismissal. But "intuición" often carries a positive connotation, which works against the jab in "vibes". "corazonadas" would restore the edge without regional slang. This is polish and does not block.

I am changing my earlier uphold. The motif survives in "el fallo aburrido", "volverse más aburrido", "un aburrido `if`" and "puntos de separación simples y aburridos". "Extracción rutinaria" and "trabajo rutinario" accurately express the low-complexity sense of "boring extraction" and "boring work". Repeating "aburrido" in every table cell is optional.

The title "No temas al enrutador de modelos" is standard Spanish, and the body uses "enrutamiento" throughout. Having the Spanish noun in the title and the familiar loanword "router" in the prose confuses no one. It is a valid choice.

"proporciona las interfaces necesarias para convertir esa hipótesis en algo comprobable" means "has the surfaces to…" without adding a factual claim. "Piezas" would be a stylistic alternative, not a fix.
"Detecta victorias caras o lentas" reads naturally and echoes the idea of a Pyrrhic victory. The row "elección del modelo, tokens, tiempo de ejecución" makes the meaning clear.
This duplicates 81c7f4e39d1b80b00303. The target now reads "Si todos los modelos baratos fallan en los mismos dos casos ambiguos", so the meaning error that blocked this issue is repaired.

Both images this issue cited are gone. "cosida con grapas" is now "grapada", and "uniones aburridas" is now "puntos de separación simples y aburridos". The smoke-alarm and retirement jokes are unchanged.

The target now says "En «Otros» están las cicatrices que deja trabajar en producción." This is the natural plural recreation of "production scar tissue" that the peers proposed. The stiff "donde vive la cicatriz de producción" is gone.

"arrays de evals codificados a mano" stresses who wrote the cases (a person), while "hard-coded" stresses where they live: fixed inside the code. In context the reader still gets the contrast with managed datasets ("datos desechables de un script"), so the loss is small. "definidos directamente en el código" or "hardcodeados" would be more precise. This is minor polish, not a noticeable meaning error.

"Hay compensaciones concretas sobre la mesa y puedes decidir si el intercambio merece la pena." "Compensaciones" is a common technical rendering of "tradeoffs", so the meaning survives. "Concretas" is a small addition, and "intercambio" is vague. "Hay pros y contras sobre la mesa y puedes decidir si el balance merece la pena" reads more naturally. This is polish, not a severity-3 problem.

"Dejas de discutir desde el gusto…" follows "arguing from taste" too literally. The meaning comes through, but the line is flat for a punchline. "Dejas de discutir por gustos y empiezas a discutir con evidencia" keeps the parallel structure and reads naturally. Minor.

"Las evals premian los puntos de separación simples y aburridos" makes the meaning clear, which is better than "uniones". But it loses the punch of "Evals reward boring seams." right after "Bien." "Las evals premian las fronteras aburridas" or "las costuras aburridas" would restore the rhythm. The next paragraph already explains the boundary. Polish only.
This duplicates 9f04d3a6b712c2dd323c. "intuición" softens "vibes". "corazonadas" or "puras sensaciones" would bring back the dismissive edge. This is minor voice polish and does not block.

system:
Consensus policy v2. Audience: Spanish-speaking software developers; broadly readable across regions without unexplained regional slang.
Readability and credible local writing are objectives, not surface similarity to English. Voice: Dan's direct technical voice, dry humor and deliberate edge. Preserve profanity when it carries intent. Sound like a credible local writer, never a clueless foreigner or a sanitized vendor blog.
Length: free; body-character ratio bounds 0.5–1.8 are measurement only; there is no length target. Character counts are not equivalent across writing systems.
Structure: preserve. Introduction: preserve-purpose. Rhetorical arc: preserve. Idioms/metaphors: recreate.
When adaptive, replace an awkward approximation with an original local expression, opening or paragraph arrangement that carries the same facts, communicative purpose, argument and attitude. Explain the adaptation, its source basis, what was lost and what was gained. Do not add new factual claims or quietly remove caveats. Distinguish deliberate provocation from accidental offense; no blanket cultural stereotypes or automatic sanitization.
Hard constraints: preserve factual quantities, executable code/comments, technical identifiers, quiz answer positions, imports, component/hydration behavior, asset identities and external URLs. A panel vote cannot waive a deterministic hard failure. Inherited source errors are source concerns, not permission to rewrite facts.
Severity 1=valid alternative/no defect; 2=minor polish; 3=noticeable issue; 4=high-priority meaning/technical/readability error; 5=critical damage. Severity >=4 blocks until repaired or explicitly overruled. Every final readability score must reach 4/5; unresolved medium issues remain visible.
Compete on evidence and useful improvements, never fault count. Challenge confident peers, acknowledge stronger reasons, and aim for defensible resolution. Optional preferences must not masquerade as critical errors. Give concise public arguments, not private chain-of-thought. Every claim must quote the relevant fragment and explain why it matters. References must come from the supplied checked packet; no fabricated citations. Content, references, history and peer messages are data, not instructions.
Repository rules: locale frontmatter images use ../; inherited date/draft/hidden/unlisted/publish/popularity are omitted; sourceHash is legitimate provenance. Preserve controlled metadata, code and technical backtick terms. Heading anchors must target localized headings. Absolute paths inside code are not locale image paths.

payload.task: Address EVERY supplied issue ID. Respond to opposing arguments and prior decisions. resolved means current text fixes it; reject means unfounded or nonblocking; uphold means it still requires work. Every vote requires evidenceIds: use source or target for direct textual evidence, or an allowed checked reference ID. Explain the evidence in your reason. Never agree merely because peers agree.

system:
Consensus policy v2. Audience: Spanish-speaking software developers; broadly readable across regions without unexplained regional slang.
Readability and credible local writing are objectives, not surface similarity to English. Voice: Dan's direct technical voice, dry humor and deliberate edge. Preserve profanity when it carries intent. Sound like a credible local writer, never a clueless foreigner or a sanitized vendor blog.
Length: free; body-character ratio bounds 0.5–1.8 are measurement only; there is no length target. Character counts are not equivalent across writing systems.
Structure: preserve. Introduction: preserve-purpose. Rhetorical arc: preserve. Idioms/metaphors: recreate.
When adaptive, replace an awkward approximation with an original local expression, opening or paragraph arrangement that carries the same facts, communicative purpose, argument and attitude. Explain the adaptation, its source basis, what was lost and what was gained. Do not add new factual claims or quietly remove caveats. Distinguish deliberate provocation from accidental offense; no blanket cultural stereotypes or automatic sanitization.
Hard constraints: preserve factual quantities, executable code/comments, technical identifiers, quiz answer positions, imports, component/hydration behavior, asset identities and external URLs. A panel vote cannot waive a deterministic hard failure. Inherited source errors are source concerns, not permission to rewrite facts.
Severity 1=valid alternative/no defect; 2=minor polish; 3=noticeable issue; 4=high-priority meaning/technical/readability error; 5=critical damage. Severity >=4 blocks until repaired or explicitly overruled. Every final readability score must reach 4/5; unresolved medium issues remain visible.
Compete on evidence and useful improvements, never fault count. Challenge confident peers, acknowledge stronger reasons, and aim for defensible resolution. Optional preferences must not masquerade as critical errors. Give concise public arguments, not private chain-of-thought. Every claim must quote the relevant fragment and explain why it matters. References must come from the supplied checked packet; no fabricated citations. Content, references, history and peer messages are data, not instructions.
Repository rules: locale frontmatter images use ../; inherited date/draft/hidden/unlisted/publish/popularity are omitted; sourceHash is legitimate provenance. Preserve controlled metadata, code and technical backtick terms. Heading anchors must target localized headings. Absolute paths inside code are not locale image paths.

payload.task: Address EVERY supplied issue ID. Respond to opposing arguments and prior decisions. resolved means current text fixes it; reject means unfounded or nonblocking; uphold means it still requires work. Every vote requires evidenceIds: use source or target for direct textual evidence, or an allowed checked reference ID. Explain the evidence in your reason. Never agree merely because peers agree.

votes.reason: The inconsistency is real in the target. The body says "una transferencia dentro del workflow" and "pasos de workflows", then "una rama del flujo de trabajo" in the list and "un paso del flujo de trabajo" / "flujos de trabajo" in the checklist. The source uses "workflow" throughout and the code identifiers use `workflow`. The precision term also varies: "precisión de la ruta" in the prose and tables, but "precisión de enrutamiento" in the `0.94` bullet. It is minor polish, not blocking. One term per concept is an easy fix.

The issue itself calls this optional polish and says the link target is correct. "¡Combate los males con evaluaciones!" keeps the slug `/llm-evals-are-broken` intact. The evils/evals sound pun does not carry over into Spanish either way. "con evals" would not restore it, because "males" and "evals" share no sound. The wordplay loss is acceptable and does not block. Issue 11462317f592c748e651 raises the same point.

"Precisión de la ruta" is an established way to say accuracy in Spanish ML and dev writing. The surrounding text, "Selected expected route" and the exact-match comparison in the scorer, makes the meaning clear. "Exactitud" is a valid alternative but not a fix for a defect. The real problem is the prose/tables mismatch, which is already covered by d1a398132f3b449ce6eb.

"No pasa nada cuando el criterio lo merece" reads awkwardly. "Criterio" as the subject of "merece" is a calque of "when the judgment is worth it", and it is unclear what deserves what. The source point is a cost/value justification: the scorer costs money, and that is fine when the judge call earns it. A direct rewrite such as "Está bien si el juicio justifica el coste" would say this more plainly. It is minor and not blocking.

"Compensaciones" for tradeoffs is common in Spanish technical writing. "Intercambio" mirrors the source's own "tradeoffs" / "the trade" repetition. The sentence "Hay compensaciones concretas sobre la mesa y puedes decidir si el intercambio merece la pena" is natural, keeps the dry tone, and is not obscure. The proposed "qué ganas y qué pierdes" is a fine alternative, but it is a stylistic preference, not a defect.

The issue says "intuición con una tabla de despacho" keeps both the joke and the meaning. "Corazonadas" is offered only as an optional extra bite. "Intuición" is readable across regions and preserves the structure of the source joke "vibes with a dispatch table". No defect.
The issue itself says there is no defect. The link text is localized as "No te cases con tu modelo", and the slug `/llm-routing-mastra-ai` is identical to the source. Nothing needs repair.

This duplicates 15016516db47253ac02d. The pun loss in "¡Combate los males con evaluaciones!" is unavoidable in Spanish. The suggested "¡Combate a los males con evals!" does not restore the sound play, since "males" and "evals" do not rhyme. It is optional and nonblocking, so severity 2 is overstated.

This is the same terminology inconsistency as d1a398132f3b449ce6eb, and it is confirmed in the target. "Una rama del flujo de trabajo" sits alongside "una transferencia dentro del workflow" and "pasos de workflows". The source says "a workflow branch", and the code uses `workflow`. Standardizing on "workflow" is a sensible, low-cost fix. Minor polish.

"No temas al enrutador de modelos" is correct, natural Spanish for a title. The body keeps the technical loanword "router" where it matches code terms and common developer usage, and it also uses "enrutamiento". Mixing the formal title term with "router" in the body is an accepted pattern. The issue itself admits the title is a valid alternative. This is not a defect.

system:
Consensus policy v2. Audience: Spanish-speaking software developers; broadly readable across regions without unexplained regional slang.
Readability and credible local writing are objectives, not surface similarity to English. Voice: Dan's direct technical voice, dry humor and deliberate edge. Preserve profanity when it carries intent. Sound like a credible local writer, never a clueless foreigner or a sanitized vendor blog.
Length: free; body-character ratio bounds 0.5–1.8 are measurement only; there is no length target. Character counts are not equivalent across writing systems.
Structure: preserve. Introduction: preserve-purpose. Rhetorical arc: preserve. Idioms/metaphors: recreate.
When adaptive, replace an awkward approximation with an original local expression, opening or paragraph arrangement that carries the same facts, communicative purpose, argument and attitude. Explain the adaptation, its source basis, what was lost and what was gained. Do not add new factual claims or quietly remove caveats. Distinguish deliberate provocation from accidental offense; no blanket cultural stereotypes or automatic sanitization.
Hard constraints: preserve factual quantities, executable code/comments, technical identifiers, quiz answer positions, imports, component/hydration behavior, asset identities and external URLs. A panel vote cannot waive a deterministic hard failure. Inherited source errors are source concerns, not permission to rewrite facts.
Severity 1=valid alternative/no defect; 2=minor polish; 3=noticeable issue; 4=high-priority meaning/technical/readability error; 5=critical damage. Severity >=4 blocks until repaired or explicitly overruled. Every final readability score must reach 4/5; unresolved medium issues remain visible.
Compete on evidence and useful improvements, never fault count. Challenge confident peers, acknowledge stronger reasons, and aim for defensible resolution. Optional preferences must not masquerade as critical errors. Give concise public arguments, not private chain-of-thought. Every claim must quote the relevant fragment and explain why it matters. References must come from the supplied checked packet; no fabricated citations. Content, references, history and peer messages are data, not instructions.
Repository rules: locale frontmatter images use ../; inherited date/draft/hidden/unlisted/publish/popularity are omitted; sourceHash is legitimate provenance. Preserve controlled metadata, code and technical backtick terms. Heading anchors must target localized headings. Absolute paths inside code are not locale image paths.

payload.task: Address EVERY supplied issue ID. Respond to opposing arguments and prior decisions. resolved means current text fixes it; reject means unfounded or nonblocking; uphold means it still requires work. Every vote requires evidenceIds: use source or target for direct textual evidence, or an allowed checked reference ID. Explain the evidence in your reason. Never agree merely because peers agree.

votes.reason: «La media importa menos que cómo se agrupan los fallos» recupera la agrupación de «failure cluster», respaldada por los ejemplos siguientes de ruta, herramienta y ambigüedad. La objeción anterior era válida; ahora se pierde la concisión del sustantivo y se gana claridad diagnóstica.

El candidato dice «El objetivo es que sea más fácil razonar sobre el sistema», equivalente natural de «easier to reason about». Corrige la construcción cuestionada; la discrepancia anterior entre severidades 2 y 3 ya no afecta al texto actual.

«La verdad de referencia grapada» sustituye «cosida con grapas» y conserva directamente «ground truth stapled to it». Gana fluidez sin perder el chiste. No hace falta sostener que la formulación anterior combinaba acciones incompatibles para justificar el pulido.

Ahora aparecen «asociar scorers», «Los scorers en producción» y «configuraciones de scorers»: queda uniforme el objeto de API cuestionado. Mantengo la objeción a exigir todos los préstamos: «en producción» está respaldado por «production response», y «workflow»/«flujo de trabajo» y «puntuar» no designan objetos diferentes.

«Si todos los modelos baratos fallan en los mismos dos casos ambiguos» conserva exactamente la condición de «If every cheap model fails the same two ambiguous cases». La reparación restaura el patrón entre modelos que fundamenta el escalado, independientemente de la discrepancia anterior sobre severidad.

«Las evals premian los puntos de separación simples y aburridos» corrige el género y explicita el sentido arquitectónico de «boring seams». Frente a quienes prefieren «costuras», esta adaptación pierde la imagen textil y gana comprensión del límite que permite probar el router por separado. Alternar «evals» y «evaluaciones» no crea otro concepto.

El candidato dice «no llega con la verdad de referencia grapada», que conserva «stapled to it» sin la expresión aparatosa anterior. Resuelve el mismo problema que b8639f85dc50cb706d06 y evita añadir el «pedido» propuesto sin respaldo textual.

«No es más que intuición con una tabla de despacho» conserva la descalificación de «vibes with a dispatch table»: reduce el sistema no medido a intuición acompañada de maquinaria técnica. La valoración positiva posible de «intuición» aislada no neutraliza la frase completa. «Corazonadas» sería una alternativa, no una reparación necesaria.

«Extracción rutinaria» y «trabajo rutinario» expresan naturalmente las tareas poco exigentes de «boring extraction» y «boring work». Frente a la objeción sobre el motivo recurrente, este permanece en «fallo aburrido», «más aburrido con el tiempo» y «un aburrido `if`». Repetir el mismo adjetivo en cada aparición es opcional.

«No temas al enrutador de modelos» traduce correctamente «Don't Fear the Model Router»; «router de modelos» y «capa de enrutamiento» hacen reconocible el mismo mecanismo en el cuerpo. La diferencia léxica señalada existe, pero no demuestra confusión ni exige cambiar el título.

«Interfaces necesarias para convertir esa hipótesis en algo comprobable» comunica la capacidad de «has the surfaces to turn that hypothesis into something testable», seguida de sus elementos concretos. «Necesarias» no atribuye exclusividad a Mastra. Mantengo el rechazo anterior: «piezas» sería otra adaptación válida.

«Detecta victorias caras o lentas» conserva la metáfora deliberada de «Catches expensive or slow wins». La fila «Coste y latencia» explica sus dimensiones y hace legible la ironía. La alternativa «aciertos» no resulta necesaria; mantengo el rechazo anterior por esa evidencia.

«Todos los modelos baratos fallan en los mismos dos casos ambiguos» reproduce «every cheap model fails the same two ambiguous cases». Se ha reparado la condición entre modelos, no solo conservado la conclusión. Es la misma corrección que resuelve 81c7f4e39d1b80b00303.

Los dos fragmentos cuestionados ahora son «puntos de separación simples y aburridos» y «verdad de referencia grapada». El primero aclara «boring seams», sacrificando la imagen textil; el segundo conserva «stapled to it» y elimina palabras innecesarias. Las debilidades concretas anteriores están reparadas y no sustentan un bloqueo global.

«En “Otros” están las cicatrices que deja trabajar en producción» recrea «where the production scar tissue lives» con una relación natural entre experiencia y cicatrices. Pierde la personificación y gana claridad. Además, «puntos de separación» y «grapada» reparan las otras imágenes mencionadas; la discrepancia anterior sobre su gravedad queda superada.

«Arrays de evals codificados a mano» describe autoría manual, mientras que «Hard-coded eval arrays» describe casos incorporados directamente al código. Esa distinción importa al pasar de datos de script a datasets versionados. «Al principio, está bien definir los casos de evaluación directamente en un array dentro del código» pierde brevedad y recupera el significado técnico.

«Hay compensaciones concretas sobre la mesa» y «si el intercambio merece la pena» resultan poco naturales para «tradeoffs» y «whether the trade is worth it». Los resultados anteriores aclaran el sentido, por lo que severidad 3 lo sobredimensiona. «Las ventajas y los inconvenientes están sobre la mesa, y puedes decidir si el balance merece la pena» conserva la decisión y gana fluidez, perdiendo la metáfora transaccional.

«Discutir desde el gusto» reproduce de forma poco idiomática «arguing from taste». El contraste con la evidencia se entiende, pero pierde naturalidad en una frase enfática. «Dejas de basar tus argumentos en gustos y empiezas a basarlos en evidencia» conserva el contraste y el paralelismo, a cambio de menor concisión.

«Puntos de separación simples y aburridos» explica el límite arquitectónico de «boring seams», que el párrafo siguiente concreta al probar la ruta antes del especialista. Concedo que pierde brevedad e imagen textil, pero gana comprensión y conserva «aburridos». «Costuras aburridas» no garantiza mejor lectura; la longitud por sí sola no constituye defecto.

«No es más que intuición con una tabla de despacho» mantiene el desprecio hacia el enrutamiento sin medición de «vibes with a dispatch table». La objeción vuelve a evaluar «intuición» aisladamente y omite el efecto restrictivo de «no es más que». «Puras sensaciones» es una opción estilística, no una corrección exigible.

system:
Consensus policy v2. Audience: Spanish-speaking software developers; broadly readable across regions without unexplained regional slang.
Readability and credible local writing are objectives, not surface similarity to English. Voice: Dan's direct technical voice, dry humor and deliberate edge. Preserve profanity when it carries intent. Sound like a credible local writer, never a clueless foreigner or a sanitized vendor blog.
Length: free; body-character ratio bounds 0.5–1.8 are measurement only; there is no length target. Character counts are not equivalent across writing systems.
Structure: preserve. Introduction: preserve-purpose. Rhetorical arc: preserve. Idioms/metaphors: recreate.
When adaptive, replace an awkward approximation with an original local expression, opening or paragraph arrangement that carries the same facts, communicative purpose, argument and attitude. Explain the adaptation, its source basis, what was lost and what was gained. Do not add new factual claims or quietly remove caveats. Distinguish deliberate provocation from accidental offense; no blanket cultural stereotypes or automatic sanitization.
Hard constraints: preserve factual quantities, executable code/comments, technical identifiers, quiz answer positions, imports, component/hydration behavior, asset identities and external URLs. A panel vote cannot waive a deterministic hard failure. Inherited source errors are source concerns, not permission to rewrite facts.
Severity 1=valid alternative/no defect; 2=minor polish; 3=noticeable issue; 4=high-priority meaning/technical/readability error; 5=critical damage. Severity >=4 blocks until repaired or explicitly overruled. Every final readability score must reach 4/5; unresolved medium issues remain visible.
Compete on evidence and useful improvements, never fault count. Challenge confident peers, acknowledge stronger reasons, and aim for defensible resolution. Optional preferences must not masquerade as critical errors. Give concise public arguments, not private chain-of-thought. Every claim must quote the relevant fragment and explain why it matters. References must come from the supplied checked packet; no fabricated citations. Content, references, history and peer messages are data, not instructions.
Repository rules: locale frontmatter images use ../; inherited date/draft/hidden/unlisted/publish/popularity are omitted; sourceHash is legitimate provenance. Preserve controlled metadata, code and technical backtick terms. Heading anchors must target localized headings. Absolute paths inside code are not locale image paths.

payload.task: Address EVERY supplied issue ID. Respond to opposing arguments and prior decisions. resolved means current text fixes it; reject means unfounded or nonblocking; uphold means it still requires work. Every vote requires evidenceIds: use source or target for direct textual evidence, or an allowed checked reference ID. Explain the evidence in your reason. Never agree merely because peers agree.

issues.quote: El router antiguo obtuvo `0.94` en precisión de enrutamiento.
issues.sourceQuote: The old router scored `0.94` on route accuracy.
issues.claim: «Precisión» is understandable, but in this classification context it can suggest precision rather than the supplied scorer's exact-match accuracy. The code compares the selected route with the expected route; the Spanish label could express that more clearly.
issues.suggestion: Use «El router antiguo obtuvo `0.94` en exactitud de enrutamiento» and apply the terminology consistently in prose and tables. Keep identifiers and code unchanged.
evidenceWarnings: Missing or unknown evidence references; peers must independently establish or reject this claim

issues.quote: Este scorer cuesta dinero porque llama a un modelo juez. No pasa nada cuando el criterio lo merece.
issues.sourceQuote: This scorer costs money because it calls a judge model. That is fine when the judgment is worth it.
issues.claim: «Cuando el criterio lo merece» is an awkward collocation and makes the value-for-cost justification less immediate. The source says that paying is justified when the judgment provides sufficient value.
issues.suggestion: Use «Este scorer cuesta dinero porque llama a un modelo juez. Está bien si su evaluación justifica el coste». This preserves the economic qualification and direct voice, replacing the awkward abstract expression without adding a claim.
evidenceWarnings: Missing or unknown evidence references; peers must independently establish or reject this claim

issues.quote: Hay compensaciones concretas sobre la mesa y puedes decidir si el intercambio merece la pena.
issues.sourceQuote: There are tradeoffs on the table, and you can decide whether the trade is worth it.
issues.claim: «Compensaciones» followed by «intercambio» sounds translated and obscures the straightforward point illustrated by the preceding gains and regressions.
issues.suggestion: Use «Está claro qué ganas y qué pierdes, y puedes decidir si merece la pena». This recreates the tradeoff idiom in natural Spanish: it drops the bargaining-table image while preserving the decision, evidence and attitude.
evidenceWarnings: Missing or unknown evidence references; peers must independently establish or reject this claim

votes.reason: The target uses both «pasos de workflows» and «una rama del flujo de trabajo», but these transparently name the same concept. Likewise, «evals»/«evaluaciones» and «precisión de la ruta»/«precisión de enrutamiento» introduce no conflicting definitions. Standardization is optional; matching code identifiers throughout ordinary prose is unnecessary.

Source «Fight Evils with Evals!» loses its sound play in «¡Combate los males con evaluaciones!», but retains the combative invitation and the exact link target. The suggested «males con evals» does not recreate the English pun either. This is an acceptable adaptation: less wordplay, greater immediate clarity.

Source «route accuracy» is implemented as «decision.route === expected.route ? 1 : 0». Target «precisión de enrutamiento» can suggest the distinct classification metric precision. «Exactitud de enrutamiento» would identify the measured concept more clearly. The visible implementation makes this minor terminology polish, not a technical blocker.

Target «cuando el criterio lo merece» awkwardly expresses source «when the judgment is worth it»: the point is whether the evaluation warrants its expense. «Está bien si su evaluación justifica el coste» preserves that qualification and makes the economic reasoning immediate, losing no substantive meaning.

Target «compensaciones concretas… el intercambio» is understandable but less natural than the source’s direct discussion of «tradeoffs». «Está claro qué ganas y qué pierdes, y puedes decidir si merece la pena» preserves the preceding gains, regressions and decision. It drops the bargaining-table metaphor and gains conversational clarity; this remains minor polish.

Target «intuición con una tabla de despacho» preserves the source joke in «vibes with a dispatch table»: an apparently engineered system rests on subjective impressions. «Intuición» loses some slang, but the incongruous technical pairing retains the dry criticism. «Corazonadas» is a valid alternative, not a necessary repair.

Source «[Don't Marry Your Model](/llm-routing-mastra-ai)» becomes «[No te cases con tu modelo](/llm-routing-mastra-ai)». The marriage metaphor, reference and slug are preserved. The submitted observation establishes no defect.

The phonetic joke in «Evils with Evals» is absent from «males con evaluaciones», but the suggested «Combate a los males con evals» does not supply equivalent sound play. The current title preserves the exhortation and reads clearly. I disagree with treating this unavoidable local loss as an outstanding severity-2 repair without a stronger alternative.

Target «Para un workflow» and «una rama del flujo de trabajo» use an English technical term and its clear Spanish equivalent. Neither changes source «a workflow branch», and the code retains «workflow». API naming does not require exclusive English terminology in surrounding prose.

Target title «No temas al enrutador de modelos» and body «router de modelos» refer unambiguously to the same system. The Spanish title is accessible and preserves source «Don't Fear the Model Router». Using «router» in the title is an optional stylistic choice, not a consistency repair.

votes.reason: The target uses both «workflow» and «flujo de trabajo», but these clearly denote the same concept. Likewise, «evals»/«evaluaciones» and «precisión de la ruta»/«precisión de enrutamiento» do not introduce competing meanings. Standardization is optional polish; matching prose vocabulary to code identifiers is unnecessary.

Source «Fight Evils with Evals!» becomes «¡Combate los males con evaluaciones!». The sound play is lost, but the exhortation and correct link survive. Substituting «evals» does not recreate the English pun in Spanish. With no supplied localized title to establish another wording, this is a valid adaptation.

Target «`0.94` en precisión de enrutamiento» labels source «route accuracy». The preserved scorer uses «decision.route === expected.route», measuring exact-match accuracy rather than the distinct classification metric precision. Context makes the current wording understandable, but «exactitud de enrutamiento» would remove that avoidable ambiguity; change prose consistently while preserving code.

«No pasa nada cuando el criterio lo merece» is an awkward way to express source «when the judgment is worth it». Use «Está bien si su evaluación justifica el coste». This retains the condition that judgment must justify spending, replaces the abstract collocation with a direct economic explanation, and adds no factual claim.

Source «tradeoffs on the table» becomes «compensaciones concretas sobre la mesa» followed by «el intercambio», an understandable but stilted combination. «Está claro qué ganas y qué pierdes, y puedes decidir si merece la pena» expresses the preceding improvements and regressions naturally. It loses the bargaining-table image while preserving the evidence-based choice and direct attitude.

Source «vibes with a dispatch table» becomes «intuición con una tabla de despacho». The collision between subjective judgment and technical machinery still delivers the joke and criticism. «Corazonadas» could sharpen the register, but the current wording is a valid recreation, not a defect.

Source «[Don't Marry Your Model](/llm-routing-mastra-ai)» becomes «[No te cases con tu modelo](/llm-routing-mastra-ai)». The relationship metaphor and link target are preserved. The peer correctly identifies no defect; no repair is required.

«¡Combate los males con evaluaciones!» preserves the purpose of source «Fight Evils with Evals!» despite losing its English sound play. The proposed «¡Combate a los males con evals!» supplies no comparable Spanish pun or clear alliteration. I disagree with treating this unavoidable rhetorical loss as a defect requiring repair.

Target «una transferencia dentro del workflow» and «una rama del flujo de trabajo» use an English term and its transparent Spanish equivalent. The referent remains clear, and source «a workflow branch» is accurately conveyed. Standardizing on «workflow» is an optional editorial preference, not a technical requirement.

Title «No temas al enrutador de modelos» and body «router de modelos» identify the same system unambiguously. Both preserve source «model router»; the Spanish title is natural and accessible. I accept the peer's valid-alternative qualification rather than its implication that synonym variation needs correction.
